notes.title: 🚨 FREE Major Update: 8 Skins, New Map, and More You Can’t Miss! 🚨
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Mannequin! This month’s update focuses on adding some exciting features and polishing gameplay to make your experience even better. Keep playing and let us know your feedback!

[h3][b]New Feature: Skins Rewards[/b][/h3]
Progression just got more rewarding! As you level up, unlock new skins for both Mannequins and Agents. This includes 4 fresh skins for Mannequins and 4 for Agents. You will be able to choose your favorite skin from a new skins tab on the progress screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968646/7e85963aa1f5b9b7412e03a80390ca4928c449b6.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Level: Backrooms[/b][/h3]
Get ready for chills and thrills in this eerie new Backrooms map! Perfect for intense Death matches and elimination matches. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968646/67e286fde025891fa5fcdbda74fa8882fc9dd9a5.png[/img]

[h3][b]Improvements: VFX Updates[/b][/h3] 
Polished VFXs for Dash and tweaks to the Possess effects.

[h3][b]Improvements: Agent Gun Display[/b][/h3]
Understand your tools like never before with our improved gun UI! Guns now display Gauss and Shield status.

[h3][b]Balancing Tweaks[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Mannequin dash cooldown reduced by a few seconds
[*] Mannequin walk speed increased by 5%
[*] Agent shield shutdown reduced by 1 second
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug fixes & Minor Improvements[/b][/h3] 
[list]
[*] A late cancelled charge-up Agent shield can no longer activate the shield
[*] Fix for EMF reader to not show a constant x-ray state
[*] Objectives are no longer visible after being respawned in Deathmatch
[*] Kill feed updates as expected
[*] Colors for Generator progress in scoreboard match Agent gun more
[*] Fix for Hand scanners to better register hands
[*] Windows in Excavation have more detailed collision
[*] Revive icon doesn’t show up on dead opponents
[/list] 

We’re constantly working to make the game better for you. Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming!

notes.title: 💥 MAJOR UPDATE: Deathmatch, New Level, New Ability & More!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Agents and Mannequins 🫡👽,

Thank you all for playing Mannequin, and a big thanks for helping make it such a highly-rated game. We're excited to bring you our second [b]FREE[/b] major update, packed with lots of new features available to [b]download now![/b]

Keep reading to discover everything included in this update 👇.

[h3][b]New Game Mode: Deathmatch[/b][/h3]
Get ready for Deathmatch! It’s the ultimate free-for-all where the player with the most kills wins. Dive into the chaos and prove you’re the best in this high-stakes showdown.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968646/be35bab38cf01341855a81580769ee623264647f.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Ability: Possess[/b][/h3]
Mannequins have a brand-new trick up their sleeves! With the Possess ability, you can now absorb first responders and place and repose them wherever you want in the level. Take control and strategize in new ways!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968646/a6c0e7d13392cef76416ce930bd09c2e742e62d5.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Level: Pagoda[/b][/h3]
Welcome to Pagoda, our latest level! Explore our ancient shrine level that was crafted with Deathmatch in mind but works great for all game modes. Get ready to explore and battle in this atmospheric arena.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968646/955e480dcc00a90a9a6907c694c2726b3d0ac0c2.png[/img]


[h3][b]Custom Game Options[/b][/h3]
Customize your experience even more with these new options:
[list]
[*] Movement Speed Modifier – Adjust how fast characters move
[*] Random Team – Players are assigned to a random team 
[*] Dash Cooldown – Set the cooldown for dashes
[*] Ammo Count – Control the amount of ammo available
[*] Auto Reload – Toggle auto-reload on or off
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Player is no longer forced standing, when being shot crouched in infected game mode
[*] Updated description for Infection game mode in Custom games settings
[*] Banned players can no longer join a custom game server that is hosted by another player
[*] Fix for Gauss vignette only playing when Agent has EMF active
[*] Left-handed input for MQ posing is on the correct hand again
[*] Players can no longer get stuck in scaffolding under “B” in Tomb 
[*] Pause Menu and Scoreboard doesn’t close when another player get killed
[/list]

Thank you for playing! Happy November gaming!

The social lobby now features a brand new game mode: King of the Crown. Steal the crown from other players and keep it on for as long as you can to earn the title of Manneking or Mannequeen.

Players can now use figure gestures to point, give thumbs up and more while playing and posing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968646/41eea77d5824daeb9f39f4bb029951f89ca4a32d.png[/img]

[b]AGENT SHIELD ABILITY[/b]
Agents have gained a new shield ability, an EMG: Electric Magnetic Guard. A temporary protection against sudden Mannequin attacks. It can be activated once every round, so use it wisely.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968646/8ed4119c015e6e368a653486622ae7826fb2b63f.png[/img]

[b]AUDIO POLISH PASS[/b]
[list]
[*] More varied ambience in all levels
[*] Improved audio occlusion to make it easier to tell where sounds are coming from
[*] New and improved sound effects across the game
[*] Improved audio feedback when using push to talk
[*] Mixing and adjustments of all audio; ambience, sound effects, music and VO
[/list] 

[b]MISC ADDITIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added full screen feedback vignettes to highlight important game events, like advantage and revival
[*] Polished and added haptics across the game
[*] The push to talk button is now activated by double tapping the left thumbstick
[/list]

[b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an update board in the lobby to highlight new and upcoming game content
[*] Custom lobby screen now let all players in a session know what map is selected as well as the game mode they’ll play
[*] Custom lobby screen has also received a polish pass to highlight relevant information and make the experience easier to navigate 
[*] The scoreboard and player interaction screens have received some overall polish and attention!
[*] Updated loading screen visuals
[*] HUD elements have had a visual overhaul, both to be less disrupting as well as more informative
[*] Team notifications (capture power generator, team advantage, team win) are now displayed with the colours of the corresponding team
[*] Prestige is now properly displayed 
[*] Expanded the player manual to display new relevant information
[*] Push to talk now has a mute/unmute indicator, to let players know if they’re in voice comms or not
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Mannequin dash aim character no longer remains when turned into agents in Infected mode
[*] Fixed custom game settings not being saved between games
[*] Agent players can no longer hear faulty EMF readings from other agents
[*] Match result notifications now appear for all players, not just the winning team
[*] The “Return to lobby” button on the end of match screen now works as intended
[*] Fixed that the light indicators on the Agent gun stopped working after the gun has been jammed
[*] Ammo is now always fully reloaded when Agents gain advantage
[/list]

We hope you love this update! If you're enjoying Mannequin we'd love for you to leave a review on the store page. Your support makes a huge difference 💙🧡.

As always, if you have any comments or questions feel free to leave them below.

/ Fast Travel Games

notes.title: Patch #1 - Infection Mode & More
notes.notes:
Greetings, Agents and Mannequins!

As promised during last week's Cross-Play Update, we have another patch ready with a host of new features. Headlining today's update is the addition of a new Infected Mode for custom games, a new Social Lobby, and more. Let's get into the main points.

We also have a key known issue for Steam Link and Virtual Desktop users to look at. Please see the bottom of this post for more information.

[b]Infected Mode For Custom Games[/b]

Players jumping into a Custom Game can now experience Mannequin's brand new Infected Mode. If you've played Infected Mode in other games then you probably know what to expect; one player starts as an Agent while the others spawn as Mannequins. Mannequins have to pose, hide and survive for three minutes to win. You can still attack Agents, but tapping them now simply jams their gun and gives you a chance to escape.

Agents, meanwhile, convert Mannequins to their team by shooting them. If all players are converted to Agents, the Agents side wins! It's a great spin on a classic mode, with our trademark hide-and-seek gameplay giving it a breath of fresh air. Make sure to jump into a Custom Game to give it a go!

[b]A New Social Lobby[/b]

One thing we’ve always wanted to do with Mannequin is provide a space where players can simply hang out without the intensity of the core game mode itself. With today’s update, we’re launching the Social Lobby, where up to 5 players can jump in, meet up, and simply hang out together, maybe jumping into a game if they want.

This doesn’t change the way you interact with Mannequin right now. You’ll still boot into a solo area, but then have the choice to head to these lobbies or start searching for a game straight away. We’ll be adding more to these lobbies – including exploring expanded player count – soon to make them a great place to hang out between games. Expect more details soon!

[b]Push To Talk Toggle[/b]

Another often requested community feature, we’ve added the ability to press a button when players want to talk into the mic. This can be really helpful with elements like background noise that can be distracting in-game!

—

There’s a few extra note-worthy additions going into today’s update too. Take a look below.

[b]All Platforms[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Infected Mode as part of Custom Games
[*] Added a Social Lobby
[*] Added in-game voice announcer
[*] Added push to talk option for voice chat
[*] Added reloading to lobby area
[*] Tutorial now has voice over
[/list]

[b]Known Issues + Workaround[/b]

There is an issue with players launching the game with Steam Link and Virtual Desktop. We are working on a fix. For now, in order to play using Steam Link or Virtual Desktop, delete the 'MetaXR' folder from SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Mannequin\Mannequin\Plugins

We'll have more updates with some exciting additions soon, so stay tuned.

Until next time, Pose and Oppose!

notes.title: Mannequin Now Live With Free Weekend!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Agents and Mannequins!

Today's the day! Mannequin is now available on PC VR via Steam. Not only that but you can [i][b]play the game for free[/b][/i] for the weekend. Our free launch weekend ends on Sunday, June 23 at 3PM CET/2PM BST/9AM ET/6AM PT, so don't miss out!

Once you've tried out the free weekend you'll be able to pick the game up at the discounted price of $14.99 for the launch period. Again, this is a limited time offer so don't skip it!

Oh, and don't forget to check out our new Accolades Trailer.

[previewyoutube=e92vqYtIB5o;full][/previewyoutube]

Quest standalone players, you'll also be able to download the Cross-Play update. This is a major jump for Mannequin as it means our App Lab fans will be able to play with PC VR users as the game goes live on Steam! We can't wait to bring more players into the fold as we head towards our 1.0 release later this year.

We also have several other updates arriving today. A huge shout out to our community, which has been instrumental in shaping a lot of the content and direction that's gone into today's update. These include:

[u][b]Finalised All Four Levels[/b][/u]

Every existing level in the game has been finalised with additions to design, art assets, lighting, first responder placement and more.

[u][b]Updated UI And Visuals[/b][/u]

New icons, colours and VFX can be found across the game. Expect a lot of smaller improvements that add up to a much cleaner, smoother experience.

[u][b]Progression Badges & Summaries[/b][/u]

A new end of match Summary Screen has been added to track players' performance. You'll also now be awarded progression badges as you rise through the ranks.

[u][b]Reporting Tool[/b][/u]

A new in-game tool to report other players can keep your Mannequin sessions safe!

And, for those that want it, here's a deeper look into the changes coming to the PC and Quest builds today. If you see a *, that means this was a suggestion made by the community!

[list]
[*] Steam version with Quest crossplay
[*] All levels are finalised (final art, level design, propping, lighting, first responder placement...)
[*] Improved visuals for PC
[*] Improved UI and iconography across the entire game
[*] Polished several VFX
[*] Added progression badges to show off player rank
[*] End of match summary with results and XP*
[*] In-game reporting tool*
[*] Updated level names and images
[*] Improved visuals and aim for ping marker
[*] Notifications when players join and leave games
[*] Enabled directional voice chat*
[*] Physical crouching is now supported*
[*] Improved posing when physically turning*
[*] It is now possible to revive players from a distance
[*] Added filters to the custom game browser
[*] Reduced peripheral flickering on Quest 3*
[*] Added blockers above elevators to prevent exploits*
[*] Various other fixes and improvements...!
[/list]

We'll have another update soon so keep an eye out for more info. Thanks for all your support so far - we've got plenty more to share!

Until then, Pose and Oppose!

notes.title: Mannequin Hits Steam Early Access June 20 With Cross-Play, Free Launch Weekend
notes.notes:
Greetings, Agents and Mannequins!

Big news today - we’re happy to confirm that the Early Access version of Mannequin will be arriving [b]next week on June 20![/b] Not only that, but we’ll have a limited time to try the game for free and then grab it at a discount. 

This version of the game features the same content as the Meta Quest edition, with updated visuals and – of course – full cross-play support. It’s a great way to experience our hide-and-seek FPS, in which a team of shape-shifting aliens known as Mannequins are hunted by a pair of elite Agents.

If you’ve already played on Quest, you’ll also notice some other changes including finalized level designs, updates to the overall UI, and the introduction of a new reporting tool. We've even added in progression badges to show off as you climb up the ranks! We’ll have more updates to the game to talk about soon.

Want to try the game out before picking it up? Then we have the perfect opportunity for you - we’re running a free trial weekend at release! Yup, from Thursday through to Sunday you’ll be able to play as much as you like at no cost. Then make sure to check out our 25% launch discount, which will be live for the first two weeks.

Until next time, Pose and Oppose!
